label.explanation: The geo-IP provider (api.geoip.example) started responding slowly (lines 152, 156) and then hanging until enrichment-svc's 30s timeout, which made ingest-api's calls to enrichment-svc time out too (lines 165, 166, 172, 173, 175, 176). Pool saturation in ingest-api (lines 178, 188, 192) is resource_exhaustion but secondary, and the ingest-gateway 503s (lines 177, 194, 200, 209, 223, 233, 238) are the paging symptom. external_outage is defensible since the third party is degraded, but the observable failure is hanging calls, so dependency_timeout is the best label. Red herrings: line 44 (a client sending one invalid request, rejected correctly with a 400).
